<definition />

XLIX, 23), and his brothers thought that he would persecute them as they did him; אבל עשו כששְׂטָמוֹ ליעקב וכ' but when Esau persecuted Jacob &c.; a. e.</notes></sense></senses>

<notes> Num. R. s. 14
<sup>5</sup> זה נ' וזה נ' this one (Jacob) was hated (Gen. XXVII, 4</notes></sense></senses></binyan></entry>

<entry id="U00760">
<head-word>שָׂטָן</head-word>
<pos> m.</pos>
<language-key>(b. h.;</language-key>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition> preced.) 
<italic>hostile being, hinderer, disturber; accuser, Satan</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Sifré Deut. 218 (ref. to Deut. XXI, 10 sq., a. 18 sq.) אביו של זה … והכניס ש' לתוך ביתו וכ' this man’s father loved a fair captive, and brought the disturber into his house, and his son became rebellious. Y. Sabb. V, 5
<sup>b</sup> top, v. קִטְיֵג. Ber. 19
<sup>a</sup>, a. e. אל יפתח אדם פיו לש' man must not open his mouth for Satan, i.e. invite misfortune by ominous words. Sabb. 89
<sup>a</sup> בשעה שירד … בא ש' וכ' when Moses had gone down from the presence of the Lord, Satan came, and said &c. Ib. בא ש' ועירבב וכ' Satan came (to the Israelites), and brought confusion into the world. R. Hash. 16
<sup>b</sup>, v. עִרְבֵּב. Yalk. Dan. 1063 ביום … נולד שְׂטָנוֹ דריוש on the day that Nebuchadnezzar entered the Temple … his adversary Darius was born. Tanḥ. Vayishl. 8 מפני שהש' מזדווג לו because Satan joins him (the wicked on his road); Yalk. Ps. 843 מפני שמלאכי ש' מלוין אותו because Satan’s messengers escort him; a. fr.—בכור ש', v. בְּכוֹר.—
<plural-form>Pl. שְׂטָנִים</plural-form>. Deut. R. s. 11, v. סַמָּאֵל. Cant. R. to I, 1 שלשה ש' נזדווגו לו three hindrances befell him (Solomon, I Kings XI, 14; 23; 25); a. e.</notes></sense></senses></entry>

<entry id="U00761">
<head-word>שָׂטָן</head-word>

<head-word>שִׂי'</head-word>
<language-key> ch. </language-key>
<language-reference>same.</language-reference>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition />
<notes> Targ. I Kings V, 18; a. fr., v. סְטַן II.—Kidd. 30
<sup>a</sup>; Succ. 38
<sup>a</sup> Ms. M. 2 (ed. ס'), v. גִּיר III. Kidd. 81
<sup>a</sup> אידמי ליה ש' כאיתתא Satan (temptation) appeared to him as a woman. Ib. הוה רגיל … גירא בעיניה דש' used to say every day, I challenge Satan, v. גִּיר III. Sabb. 32
<sup>a</sup> ש' בתרי אומי וכ' Satan has no power over two persons of different nationalities (on the same boat &c.); a. e.—V. סְטַן II.—
<plural-form>Pl. שִׂטְנֵי, שׂוֹטְנֵי,</plural-form> v. סְטַן II.</notes></sense></senses></entry>

<entry id="U00762">
<head-word>שָׁטַף</head-word>
<language-key>(b. h.;</language-key>
<language-reference>
<xref rid="I00195"> cmp. טוּף</xref>,
<xref rid="I00676"> טָפַף II)</xref></language-reference>
<senses>
<sense>
<number>1)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to wash, rinse</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Zeb. XI, 6 (94
<sup>b</sup>) ושׁוֹטְפוֹ, v. מָרַק; Tosef. ib. X, 13 ושׁוֹטְפָן. Tosef. Ḥull. X, 4 השׁוֹטֵף רחיליו חייב וכ' if one washes his lambs (in place of clipping), he is bound to give the priest’s share of the wool (that they shed); Ḥull. 137
<sup>a</sup>; a. fr.—Part. pass. שָׁטוּף. Sabb. 99
<sup>a</sup> (ref. to Ex. XXXV, 26) ש' בעזים וטווו בעזים Ms. M. (ed. מן העזים) the hair was washed on the goats and spun on the goats; ib. 74
<sup>b</sup>; Yalk. Ex. 370.</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—2)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to flood, carry off, drown</italic>.</definition>
<notes> B. Mets. VIII, 5 ש' נהר זיתיו וכ' if a stream carried off one’s olive-trees and deposited them in a neighbor’s field. B. Kam. X, 4 (115
<sup>b</sup>) ש' נהר חמורו וכ' (Bab. ed. נחל) if a stream (ravine) carried off his own and his neighbor’s ass …, and he let go his own and saved his neighbor’s. Ib. 5 (117
<sup>b</sup>) שְׁטָפָהּ נהר if the river washed it (the unlawfully taken field) away. Yoma 78
<sup>a</sup> נחל שׁוֹטֵף a swiftly running brook. Y. Shek. I, 46
<sup>a</sup> ירד שֶׁטֶף … ושְׁטָפוֹ a rain shower came down and washed it (the mark on the grave) off. Y. B. Mets. VIII, end, 11
<sup>d</sup> בששְׁטָפָן (not בששטן), v. גּוּשׁ. Ex. R. s. 24 נתמלא … ובקש לשׁוֹטְפָן the genius of the sea became wroth against them, and wanted to drown them. Num. R. s. 19
<sup>9</sup> ויצאו מים רבים ושָׁטְפוּ כל וכ' many waters came forth, and flooded all those who murmured; Midr. Till. to Ps. LXXVIII, 20 (corr. acc.); a. fr.—V. שָׁטוּף.</notes></sense></senses>
<pgbrk id="pg1555" />
<binyan>
<binyan-name>Hif.</binyan-name>
<binyan-form>הִשְׁטִיף</binyan-form>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition> same.</definition>
<notes> Taan. 6
<sup>a</sup> ומַשְׁטִיף את הזרעים (Ms. M. ששׁוֹטֵף, v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note) it (the heavy rain) washes the seeds away; Yalk. Joel 535 ומְשַׁטֵּף (
<italic>Pi.</italic>).—
<italic>Part.</italic> pass. מוּשְׁטָף; 
<plural-form>pl. מוּשְׁטָפִים</plural-form>
<italic>carried off, floating</italic>. Ex. R. l. c. לפי שראו … מ' על פני המים because they saw the bodies … floating on the water.</notes></sense></senses></binyan>
<binyan>
<binyan-name>Nif.</binyan-name>
<binyan-form>נִשְׁטַף, </binyan-form>
<binyan-name>Hithpa.</binyan-name>
<binyan-form>הִשְׁתַּטֵּף, </binyan-form>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition>, 
<italic>Nithpa.</italic> נִשְׁתַּטֵּף </definition>
<notes /></sense>
<sense>
<number>1)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to be washed, showered upon; to take a shower bath</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Sabb. 40
<sup>a</sup> ויוצא ומִשְׁתַּטַּף וכ' and goes out (of the steam-room), and takes a shower bath in the outer room. Ib.
<sup>b</sup> ובלבד שלא יִשְׁתַּטֵּף וכ' but he must not have a cold shower bath and then warm himself &c. Tosef. ib. III (IV), 4; a. fr.</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—2)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to be swept away, drowned</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Sifré Deut. 307 מה ראו … שנִשְׁטְפוּ במים why were the men of the flood drowned in water?; Yalk. ib. 942 שיִשָּׁטְפוּ; Sifré l. c. מה … להִשְׁתַּטֵּף באש וכ' why were the men of Sodom … swept away by fire and sulphur?; Yalk. l. c. להִשָּׁטֵף; a. e.—Trnsf. 
<italic>to be carried away by passion</italic>. Num. R. s. 9
<sup>17</sup>; Sifré Num. 12 הרבה קידמוך ונִשְׁטְפוּ many women before thee have been carried away (into infidelity).</notes></sense></senses></binyan></entry>

<entry id="U00763">
<head-word>שְׁטֵף</head-word>
<head-word>שְׁטֵיף</head-word>
<language-key> ch. </language-key>
<language-reference>same</language-reference>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition>, </definition>
<notes /></sense>
<sense>
<number>1)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to wash, rinse</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Targ. I Kings XXII, 38. Targ. II Sam. XI, 8; a. e.—Tam. 27
<sup>b</sup> שְׁטוֹף ושתי שטוף ואחית rinse (the cup) and drink, rinse, and set it down; a. e.</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—2)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to overflow, flood, wash away</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Targ. Ps. LXXVIII, 20 ישטפון מיא Ms. (omitted in ed.). Targ. Is. XXXIII, 21. Targ. Y. II Num. XXI, 16. Targ. Ps. CXXIV, 4; a. e.—Naz. 32
<sup>b</sup> שַׁטְפוּהוּ ובנן וכ' the Rabbis carried R. El. away, and made him stand on their principle, i.e. made him give up his opinion and adopt theirs. Succ. 53
<sup>a</sup> למִשְׁטְפָא וכ', v. קְפֵי; a. e.</notes></sense></senses>
<binyan>
<binyan-name>Pa.</binyan-name>
<binyan-form>שַׁטֵּף</binyan-form>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition>
<italic>to wash</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Y. Ber. VIII, 12
<sup>a</sup> bot. ולא מְשַׁטֵּף ידוי וכ' and did not wash his hands up to the joints.</notes></sense></senses></binyan></entry>

<entry id="U00764">
<head-word>שֶׁטֶף</head-word>
<pos> m.</pos>
<language-key>(b. h.;</language-key>
<language-reference>
<xref rid="U00763">preced.</xref></language-reference>
<senses>
<sense>
<number>1)</number>
<definition>
<italic>flood, shower</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Y. Shek. I, 46
<sup>a</sup>, v. שָׁטַף. Gen. R. s. 73 ש' של גשמים a flood caused by rains (brought the rams from Laban’s fold to Jacob’s); Yalk. ib. 130; a. e.—Trnsf. 
<italic>passion, anger</italic>. Lev. R. s. 24, beg. בזמן שהוא נותן … שיש ש' בדינו when he orders execution (punishment), none praise him, for they know that there is passion in his judgment; Yalk. Ps. 843; Y. Ber. IX, 14
<sup>b</sup></notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—2)</number>
<definition>
<italic>washing, rinsing;</italic> כלי ש' a vessel which requires only rinsing in order to be restored to Levitical cleanness.</definition>
<notes> Ḥull. 25
<sup>a</sup>; Zeb. 3
<sup>b</sup>; a. e.</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—3)</number>
<definition>
<italic>wool that is gained by washing</italic>.</definition>
<notes>. Sifré Deut. 166 (ref. to Deut. XVIII, </notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>4)</number>
<definition> ראשית גז ולא ראשית הש' the first of the wool that is cut, but not the first of the wool that comes out by washing.</definition>
<notes>—4) ש' של עזים 
<italic>goat</italic>
<italic>-</italic>
<italic>skin made hairless by washing</italic>. Cant. R. to IV, 11; Gen. R. s. 65; Yalk. ib. 115 אין לך … מהש' וכ' there is no smell more offensive than that of washed goat-skins.</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—5)</number>
<definition>
<italic>hair that is fallen out, bald pate</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Koh. R. to I, 8 (in enigmatic speech) שִׁיטְפִי מאלל (not שיטפו) my hair is going.</notes></sense></senses></entry>

<entry id="U00765">
<head-word>שִׁטְפָא</head-word>
<head-word>שִׁי'</head-word>
<language-key> ch. </language-key>
<language-reference>same</language-reference>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition>, </definition>
<notes /></sense>
<sense>
<number>1)</number>
<definition>
<italic>flood, shower</italic>.</definition>
<notes>. Targ. Job XXXVIII, 25.</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—2)</number>
<definition>
<italic>rapidity</italic>, (cmp. שגר) 
<italic>rapid review in recalling a tradition</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Sabb. 130
<sup>b</sup> דילמא אגב שִׁיטְפָךְ רהיט וכ' perhaps in the rapidity of reviewing, the tradition came back to thy mind?; אין אגב ש' רהיטא וכ' (Ms. M. שִׁיטְפָאִי, v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note) yes, my tradition was recalled by the (my) rapid review; Nidd. 53
<sup>b</sup> אגב שטפך אתיא לך; אגב שטפאי אתיא לי.</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—3)</number>
<definition>
<italic>rush of people</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Y. Sabb. XIX, beg. 16
<sup>d</sup> כד תחמון ש' עבר וכ' when you see the crowd pass by, bring them (the keys) by way of the row (the lines of men forming a partition for Sabbath purposes).</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—4)</number>
<definition> [
<italic>sweeping away</italic>, cmp. נסח, נסע,] 
<italic>discarding from the mind, forgetfulness</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Gen. R. s. 81, v. עָקַת; Yalk. ib. 135 שִׁטּוּפָא; Tanḥ. Vayishl. 8 שמטי.</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—5)</number>
<definition> (v. preced. 5) 
<italic>hair</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Lev. R. s. 15 (ref. to Job XXXVIII, 25) אית אתרין … שי' there are places where they call the hair 
<italic>shiṭfa;</italic> Yalk. ib. 554 שִׁיטְפָה.</notes></sense></senses></entry>

<entry id="U00766">
<head-word>*שְׂטַר</head-word>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition> = סְטַר 
<italic>to slap</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Y. Shebi. IV, 35
<sup>b</sup> bot. ש' ותלי ביה he slaps (the fig-tree) &c., v. תָּחוּב. [Comment. refer to שְׁטַר: he smears clay over it.]</notes></sense></senses></entry>

<entry id="U00767">

<entry id="U00768">
<head-word>שְׁטַר</head-word>
<language-key> ch. </language-key>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition>(preced.) 
<italic>to draw, spread, strike</italic> (butter, salve &c.).</definition>
<notes> Targ. Is. XXXVIII, 21 ויִשְׁטְרוּן ed. Vien. (ed. Lag. וישיטרון; ed. Wil. וישורטון), v. שְׁטַח.—Gitt. 69
<sup>b</sup> ונִשְׁטְרִינְהוּ בכמכא and let him strike 
<italic>kamakh</italic> (v. כָּמַךְ) over it; (Rashi: let him soak it in k.). Ib. ונשטרינהו בדובשא and strike honey over it. Pes. 44
<sup>a</sup> אי מִשְׁטַר קָשְׁטַר וכ' if he spreads it (on bread) and eats it (Rashi: if he dips bread into it); Naz. 36
<sup>b</sup>. B. Mets. 85
<sup>b</sup> אִשְׁטַר לך משטר I will smear thee a salve (over thy eyes).</notes></sense></senses></entry>

<entry id="U00769">
<head-word>שֶׁטֶר</head-word>

<senses>
<sense>
<definition> (v. 
<xref rid="U00390">שׁוֹטֵר</xref>) 
<italic>executive office, execution</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Yalk. Deut. 907 אלמלא שִׁטְרוֹ של יואב וכ' but for the executive office of Joab, David could not have executed justice; Yalk. Sam. 147 שוטרו (read: שִׁיטְרוֹ); Tanḥ. Shof’ṭim 2 סיטנו; ed. Bub. 3 שיטנו (corr. acc.).</notes></sense></senses></entry>

<entry id="U00770">
<head-word>שְׁטָר</head-word>
<head-word>שְׁטַר</head-word>
<pos> m.</pos>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition> (v. 
<xref rid="U00766">שָׁטַר</xref>) 
<italic>writ, document</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Kidd. I, 1 a woman may be acquired as wife בכסף בש' וכ' by handing her money (or money’s worth), by a writ (handing her a paper on which is written, ‘thou art betrothed unto me’) &c. Ib. 2 a slave is acquired בש' by a document (bill of sale). Ib. 3

<senses>
<sense>
<definition> (שטט, cmp. שִׁרְטֵט) l) 
<italic>row, line</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Neg. X, 6 וש' של שער וכ' and a row of hair separating them. Y. Kidd. II, 62
<sup>d</sup> אשה … ושי' של וכ' (not שוטה) a bald-headed woman with a row of hair going around from ear to ear. Y. Yoma IV, 41
<sup>c</sup> top אני ראיתיו … אלא ש' אחת וכ' I have seen it (the high priest’s mitre) in Rome, and there was engraved on it only in one line, ‘holy unto the Lord’. Tosef. Gitt. IX (VII), 11 מלא ש' אחת the space of one line (of writing); Y. ib. IX, 50
<sup>c</sup>; Y. B. Bath. X, beg. 17
<sup>c</sup>. Treat. Sof’rim XII, 8; a. fr.—
<plural-form>Pl. שִׁיטִּין, שִׁטִּ'</plural-form> (m.), שִׁיטּוֹת. Ib. שִׁיטּוֹתֶיהָ של תורה the division of lines in the Pentateuch. Ib. 9 סימן תחלת הש' וכ' the mark for the beginning of lines (in 
<italic>Haăzinu</italic>, Deut. XXXII) is, 
<italic>Haazinu, Yaʿarof</italic> &c. Y. B. Bath. l. c. מקום שני ש' the space of two lines; Tosef. Gitt. l. c.; Y. ib. l. c. Ḥull. 65
<sup>a</sup> בשתי תיבות פסיק להו בשני ש' וכ' written as two separate words, but not divided between two lines; a. fr.—2) (trnsf.) 
<italic>line of thought, opinion, principle, system</italic>. Lev. R. s. 2 אמר ש' אחרת offered a second mode (of developing the same idea from two Scripture verses). Y. Gitt. V, 47
<sup>c</sup> top; Y. Erub. VII, 24
<sup>c</sup> bot. ירדו לה בשִׁיטַּת וכ' they entered into (drew an analogy from) the principle laid down in the law concerning transactions of children. Erub. 99
<sup>a</sup>, a. e. מוחלפת הש', v. חָלַף; (Rashi: R. J. is at variance with his own principle, v. שִׁיטְּתָא). Y. Pes. VII, beg. 34
<sup>a</sup> בשיטת ר' מאיר following up R. Meir’s principle. Y. Peah V, 19
<sup>a</sup> top [read:] בשִׁיטָּתָן השיבהו בשִׁיטַּתְכֶן דאתון אמרין וכ' he (R. El.) argued against them by entering into their opinion (without adopting it for himself); according to your principle, when you say &c.; a. fr. (in Chald. diction, v. שִׁיטְּתָא).—
<plural-form>Pl. שִׁיטִּין</plural-form>. Num. R. s. 19
<sup>9</sup> (ref. to המרים, Num. XX, 10) ש' הרבה יש בו there are several ways of interpreting that word; a. e.</notes></sense></senses></entry>

<notes> B. Kam. 92
<sup>b</sup> ש' ואזיל וכ' Ar. (ed. מטייל) the bad palm tree belongs to and goes &c., v. שְׂרָכָא. Ab. Zar. 72
<sup>b</sup> כולי חמרא … ש' Ar. (ed. גריר) all the wine in the cask is connected with that in the siphon, v. גְּרַר. B. Mets. 98
<sup>b</sup> שכירה … מֵישַׁךְ שייכא דהא וכ' (not שייכי, v. Rashi) shall we say, the action of hiring is connected with that of lending, because in both cases there is the same responsibility for theft and loss (and therefore the act of hiring after lending is only a continuation of, and has had its beginning simultaneously with the lending)?, opp. לחודה קיימא. Ib. שכרה … ודאי לא ש' או דילמא כיון דש' וכ' if he hired the animal to be used in the presence of the owner, and then borrowed it without him, shall we say, lending is surely not connected with hiring (since the laws of responsibility are different), or shall we say, because they are related in some respects, they may be considered entirely related (so that the two acts may be treated as of the same date)? B. Kam. 15
<sup>a</sup> נכרי משום דלא ש' במצות the gentile (is disqualified as witness), because he has no relation to the Jewish religious duties; אבל עבד דש' במצות וכ' but the slave (of a Jew) who has some relation to religious duties (being bound to observe certain religious laws) &c. Kidd. 42
<sup>a</sup> אם אינו ענין להיכא דש' וכ' if the text has no application to where it belongs (to the subject under consideration), apply it to where it does not belong (v. עִנְיָן). Y. Ab. Zar. I, 39
<sup>d</sup> bot. עז דלא ש' בה גיזה a goat to which the law concerning the first-shorn wool does not apply; a. fr.—
<plural-form>Pl. שָׁיְיכֵי</plural-form>. Gitt. 28
<sup>b</sup> במילתא דלא ש' בה וכ' in a thing in which they are not interested (and may be apt to boast of their feats): but in a thing in which they are interested, they are likely to cling to their lies.</notes></sense></senses></entry>

II, 5, a. e. שבעים אמה וש' seventy cubits and a balance (less than eighty); Y. ib. II, 20
<sup>b</sup> שריים (corr. acc.). Zeb. 52
<sup>a</sup> שירי חטאת the remaining blood of the sin offering after sprinkling (Lev. IV, 34, a. e.). Ib. ש' אין מעכבים the pouring out of the remaining blood at the bottom of the altar is not indispensable for the efficacy of the sacrifice (v. עָכַב); Meïl. 9
